description: chartBars 5 over [0, 10], 32 rows of 0.3125: bar 0 spreads 1 unit over every row, bars 1-4 are zero-range at 5 with 10 each (row floor(5/0.3125) = 16). The profile on bar 5 excludes bar 5 itself. POC row 16 = 5.15625; 40 of 41 units exceed the 70% target, so the value area is that single row [5, 5.3125].
